items.title: Luna Agent – Custom AI agent in ~2300 lines of Python, no frameworks
items.raw_excerpt:
Hey HN. I evaluated three agent frameworks for a homelab project, one had 400K lines of code (and 42K exposed instances on Shodan), one was 9 days old, and the third was so thin I'd rebuild most of it anyway. None worked for me. So I built my own in ~2300 lines of Python. No frameworks, 8 runtime dependencies, 106 tests. What it does:
- Persistent memory via SQLite (FTS5 keyword search + sqlite-vec embeddings + recency decay, fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion)
- MCP tool integration — add capabilities by editing a JSON file
- Native tools with safety guardrails (bash blocklist, timeouts, output caps)
- Discord interface with session isolation
- Structured JSON logging for every operation
- Conversation compression for effectively infinite context Runs locally on 2x RTX 3090 with Qwen3-Code

excerpt_i18n.zh: “2023 年初我们就已经明确要做可交互的 3D 内容。” 作为 VAST 的创始人，宋亚宸回忆起当时创业的渊源，语气依旧笃定。在他的判断里，3D 生成迟迟没有真正普及，并不是因为技术路线不清晰，而是因为“到现在为止，其实都没有真正意义上的 3D UGC 平台”。 （雷峰网雷峰网雷峰网） 这也是VAST选择从工具和模型入手，而不是等平台成熟后再进入的原因。在他看来，平台形态或许尚未出现，但内容生产方式的变化已经足够明确。 见到宋亚宸时，他正坐在办公室的桌前吃午饭。当天上午，一场访谈活动刚刚结束，他抓紧空档简单吃了几口，下午还有新的会面安排。月底，他还将飞往美国参加 GDC（游戏开发者大会）。 VAST 是一家成立于 2023年的人工智能公司，专注于通用 3D 大模型的研发与落地产品建设，其核心产品Tripo Studio（一站式 AI 3D 工作台），VAST 在 Tripo 系列中的两项核心突破，分别指向不同的 3D 生成方向：H3.1 强调高保真、高还原度的 3D 资产生成，而 P1.0 则聚焦于“可用性”——以接近人工建模的拓扑结构，实现极高速的 3D 资产生成。 对于游戏、XR 和 3D UGC 等实时引擎场景而言，真正决定资产能否被直接使用的，并不只是面数高低，而是拓扑是否干净、布线是否稳定，以及能否无缝进入 Unity、Unreal 等引擎管线继续编辑与部署。 打个比方，可以把 3D 模型理解成一件由很多小三角形拼成的“外壳”。三角形越多，细节就越丰富，但也越“费劲”。像 5000 面左右的低模，相当于一张分辨率不高、但足够清晰的图片，肉眼看来已经足以呈现出栩栩如生的逼真细节：轮廓和结构的完成度尚可，却不会给设备带来算力负担。 正因为如此，这类模型才能被广泛用在游戏、XR 和面向普通用户的 3D UGC 场景中，既能实时交互，又能规模化使用。 在商业落

At the beginning of 2023, we had already decided to focus on interactive 3D content. As the founder of VAST, Song Yachen recalled the origins of the startup with unwavering conviction. In his view, the delayed widespread adoption of 3D generation is not due to unclear technological paths, but because there has yet to be a true 3D UGC platform. This is why VAST chose to start with tools and models rather than waiting for a mature platform. In his opinion, while the platform form may not yet exist, the shift in content production methods is already clear.

When meeting Song Yachen, he was sitting at his office desk having lunch. Earlier that morning, an interview had just concluded, and he took a brief break to eat a few bites before his next meeting in the afternoon. At the end of the month, he will fly to the United States to attend GDC (Game Developers Conference).

VAST is an AI company founded in 2023, focusing on the research and development of general-purpose 3D large models and the implementation of practical products. Its core product, Tripo Studio (an all-in-one AI 3D workstation), features two key breakthroughs in the Tripo series, each targeting different directions in 3D generation: H3.1 emphasizes high-fidelity, highly accurate 3D asset generation, while P1.0 focuses on "usability"—achieving extremely fast 3D asset generation with topology structures close to manual modeling.

excerpt_i18n.es: Ya a principios de 2023 teníamos claro que queríamos crear contenido 3D interactivo. Como fundador de VAST, Song Yachen recuerda los orígenes de su emprendimiento con un tono igual de firme. On March 5, 2026, the Yangtze River Delta (Deqing) Embodied Intelligence Data Collection Training Ground and the launch event for the industry's first physical AI data foundation platform, "Boundless," hosted by Unquestionable Intelligence Technology, concluded successfully at the Deqing International Conference Center. Themed "Boundless Expansion, Building the Future," the event brought together top experts and scholars in embodied intelligence, leading industry partners, representatives from renowned investment institutions, and government officials from provincial, municipal, district, and county levels. Through keynote speeches, product launches, technical sharing sessions, roundtable discussions, and on-site visits, participants explored new pathways for breakthroughs in embodied intelligence data and its practical applications.  

As a globally leading provider of physical AI data foundations, Unquestionable Intelligence Technology showcased multiple core segments at the event, including guest speeches, core product launches, in-depth technical sharing, high-end roundtable forums, and on-site visits to the training ground. These segments comprehensively demonstrated the company's robust technical capabilities in embodied intelligence data, forward-looking industry strategies, and firm commitment to building an industrial ecosystem. Attendees also gained an immersive experience of the new possibilities in the development of the embodied intelligence industry.  

At the beginning of the event, relevant leaders from Deqing County delivered speeches, extending warm congratulations on the launch of the Boundless data foundation platform and expressing high recognition for the concept of the Yangtze River Delta (Deqing) Embodied Intelligence Data Collection Training Ground as an open, shared, and mutually beneficial industrial data infrastructure.  

Dr. Yu Kai, founder of Horizon Robotics and chief advisor of Unquestionable Intelligence Technology, delivered a keynote speech titled "High-Quality Data Drives Embodied Intelligence."
excerpt_i18n.es: El 5 de marzo de 2026, el evento de lanzamiento del campo de entrenamiento para la recopilación de datos de inteligencia corpórea en el Delta del Yangtsé (Deqing) y la primera plataforma base de datos de IA física del sector, "Sin Límites", organizado por WuWen Intelligence, concluyó con éxito en el Centro Internacional de Conferencias de Deqing. Bajo el lema "Expandir Fronteras Sin Límites, Cimentar el Futuro", la conferencia reunió a destacados expertos académicos, socios industriales líderes, representantes de reconocidas instituciones de inversión y autoridades gubernamentales de diversos niveles provinciales, municipales y locales. A través de discursos temáticos, presentaciones de productos, intercambios tecnológicos, mesas redondas y visitas in situ, se exploraron conjuntamente nuevas vías para superar los desafíos de los datos de inteligencia corpórea y su aplicación práctica. Imagen: Expandir Fronteras Sin Límites, Cimentar el Futuro. Como proveedor líder mundial de bases de datos de IA física.
